title: Price Calculator Range Update, Vibrating Icons, Section Header & Color Refresh

requirements.text: Update the SofaPriceCalculator component so that the area/size input is a scrollable range selector from 5 to 30 feet (in 1-foot increments), priced at 90 Rs per foot. The calculated price should update live as the user scrolls/selects the foot value. Remove or replace any previous pricing logic for this range with the new 90 Rs/foot rate.

quotes: Price calculator je scroll varu htu foot na 90 rs varu te Kari aapo 5 thi 30 foot sudhi

acceptanceCriteria: The calculator shows a scrollable/range input from 5 to 30 feet
Price is calculated as selected feet × 90 Rs
Price updates in real time as the user changes the foot value
Minimum selectable value is 5 feet, maximum is 30 feet

requirements.text: Add a prominent heading 'Best Sofa Cleaning Ahmedabad' at the very top of the page (above or inside the Hero section), styled in attractive white text with a subtle contrasting background or overlay, making it immediately visible to visitors.

requirements.text: Update the FloatingContactButtons component so that both the Call and WhatsApp icons have a continuous vibrate + shining/glowing animation. The vibrate effect should be a subtle shake/wiggle keyframe animation, and the shining effect should be a pulsing glow or shimmer that cycles continuously to draw attention.

requirements.text: Refresh the overall page background and section backgrounds to use varied attractive light modern colors — such as soft mint, warm ivory, light peach, pale lavender, or gentle sky tones — alternating across sections so each section feels visually distinct yet cohesive. The primary text and card backgrounds should remain clean white. Avoid dark or heavy colors; keep the palette bright, airy, and modern.
